in_sanskrit.name: अमरानाथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is the lord or master of the immortal or deathless.

in_hindi.name: Amaranaath
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Immortal God
in_hindi.long_meaning: Amaranaath एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from 'Amar' (immortal) and 'Nath' (god or lord), Amaranaath refers to a god or lord who is considered immortal in Hindu mythology.

in_tamil.name: Amaranaath
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Immortal God
in_tamil.long_meaning: Amaranaath ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from 'Amar' (immortal) and 'Nath' (god or lord), Amaranaath refers to a god or lord who is considered immortal in Hindu mythology.

in_telugu.name: Amaranaath
in_telugu.long_meaning: Amaranaath ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from 'Amar' (immortal) and 'Nath' (god or lord), Amaranaath refers to a god or lord who is considered immortal in Hindu mythology.

in_marathi.name: Amaranaath
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amaranaath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from 'Amar' (immortal) and 'Nath' (god or lord), Amaranaath refers to a god or lord who is considered immortal in Hindu mythology.

in_bengali.name: Amaranaath
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Immortal God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Amaranaath একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from 'Amar' (immortal) and 'Nath' (god or lord), Amaranaath refers to a god or lord who is considered immortal in Hindu mythology.
